notes: §1985:X.4.3.2 gives the IPC 01 entry '01 [data-name-1|FILLER] [REDEFINES data-name-2] [IS EXTERNAL] [IS GLOBAL]' plus the Nucleus clauses, written in any order after the name and REDEFINES (§1985:VI.5.3.3 SR2). The grammar's dataDescriptionEntry takes every clause in any order; ClauseCardinalities refuses a clause written twice (COBOL2423), ScreenLeadingClausePosition refuses REDEFINES after GLOBAL/EXTERNAL (COBOL2739), ClausePlacementRules refuses EXTERNAL with REDEFINES, at level 05 or in LINKAGE, GLOBAL at 05 and GLOBAL/EXTERNAL without a data-name (COBOL2404), and the 2002 additions (EXTERNAL AS, TYPEDEF, BASED, NATIONAL, BINARY-LONG, GROUP-USAGE, DYNAMIC LENGTH, POINTER, GLOBAL in LINKAGE) are COBOL0900 at 85. Probed at 85: ODO table and refmod at bounds inside GLOBAL and EXTERNAL records read correctly from a contained program; every format clause and usage (S9(18) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, BINARY, COMP 18 digits, PACKED-DECIMAL negative scaled, JUST RIGHT, BLANK WHEN ZERO edited, SYNC LEFT, INDEX, VALUE ALL literal, OCCURS ASCENDING KEY INDEXED BY) with GLOBAL ran right; the witness shares GLOBAL, EXTERNAL and REDEFINES-GLOBAL items with a contained program.
